messages.text:
Cleo: Wow, what a surprise!
Rio: Wow, what a surprise!

I've got to get stronger so
I can take care of Rio!

You've only got one Pokémon with you?
You can't battle both of us like that!
It's so fun to battle alongside Cleo!{be01}

You only have one Pokémon
that's ready for battle?{be01}
Too bad! Two-against-two Pokémon
battles are really fun, you know?
